quote: Moviegoers are generally not brand conscious and usually choose a theatre based on its location, the films showing there and its amenities.
why: 観客は「not brand conscious」で「location」と上映作品で劇場を選ぶと述べ、顧客側の乗り換え費用の機構が無い。

quote: The principal elements of competition for our most significant product applications, residential and commercial water meters for the municipal water utility market (with various radio technology systems), are price, product technology, quality and service.
why: 競争要素は「price, product technology, quality and service」という一般的な記述だけで、摩擦の機構の名指しが無い。

quote: The adult entertainment business is highly competitive with respect to price, service and location.
why: 「highly competitive」で「price, service and location」を競う一般的な競争記述だけで、乗り換え費用に触れない。

quote: Furthermore, if our land-based or online gaming content does not meet or sustain revenue and profitability expectations, they may be replaced by our competitors' products or removed altogether or we may experience a reduction in fees generated from our arrangements.
why: 不振な製品は「replaced by our competitors' products」になると述べ、顧客が負う摩擦の機構は無い。

quote: We have multi-year contracts with the majority of our customers.
why: 「multi-year contracts」を大半の顧客と結ぶと断定し複数年の購買義務を名指し。顧客の再認定は述べていない。

quote: Many of our products contain surrender charges and other features that are designed to reward persistency and penalize the early withdrawal of funds.
why: 「surrender charges」が「penalize the early withdrawal」と途中解約の費用を契約者に負わせる機構を名指し。

quote: Many of our client engagement agreements are short term in nature (less than one year) or can be terminated by our clients with little or no notice and without penalty.
why: 契約は「short term」で顧客は「without penalty」で解約できると明記し、顧客は乗り換えの費用を負わない。

quote: Furthermore, all of our properties must be entirely re-leased each year, exposing us to increased leasing risk.
why: 物件は「entirely re-leased each year」で入居者は毎年離れられ、「leasing risk」を負うのは当社。顧客側の摩擦は無い。

quote: In many markets, there are significant barriers to entry limiting the number of qualified suppliers. These barriers result from stringent product performance standards, product qualification protocols and requirements for consistent levels of global service and support.
why: 「product qualification protocols」が「qualified suppliers」を限ると名指すが、顧客の再認定は断定していない。

quote: The discount segment is a challenging marketplace, with consumers having less brand loyalty and placing greater emphasis on price.
why: 消費者は「less brand loyalty」で「greater emphasis on price」と述べ、価格で乗り換える市場で摩擦の機構が無い。

quote: Our substantial installed base of products with end-users such as the railroads and the passenger transit authorities is a significant competitive advantage for providing products and services to the aftermarket because these customers often look to purchase safety- and performance-related replacement parts from the original equipment components supplier.
why: 「installed base」の上で顧客が「replacement parts」を元の供給者から買うと設置基盤の機構を名指し。再認定の断定は無い。

quote: Our products primarily compete on the basis of price, performance, speed of delivery, quality and customer support.
why: 「compete on the basis of price, performance」という一般的な競争記述だけで、乗り換え費用の機構が無い。
